trimmed_dict.title: Finals at Alden
trimmed_dict.description:
Join us at Alden Library for a variety of events to help you de-stress during Finals! 
 

Monday, 4/20 - Bookmark making (1-3pm, 4th floor lobby)
4-H PetPALS (6:30-8pm, 2nd floor near cafe)

Tuesday, 4/21 - Button & Magnet making (10am-12pm, 4th floor lobby)

Wednesday, 4/22 - Zine Making (4-6pm, Room 251)

Thursday, 4/23 - S'mores and Popcorn (3-5pm, 2nd floor near cafe)

Friday, 4/24 - Lost & Found Reclaimed Treasures (12 noon, 2nd floor near cafe) 

Monday, 4/27 - Button & Magnet making (1-3 pm, 4th floor lobby)
Affirmation Mirrors with Counseling Services (3-5pm, 4th floor lobby)

Tuesday, 4/28 - Bookmark making (10am-12pm, 4th floor lobby)
Coloring and De-Stressing with Counseling Services (3-5pm, 4th floor lobby), PetPALS (6:30-8pm, 2nd floor near cafe)
